# Room Redo

> Room Redo redesigns your own room from a single photo, in 47 styles, from Japandi to a cat lounge. It is an iPhone app.

Snap one photo. Pick a style. Watch your own room change.

## Links

- [Website](https://www.airoomredo.com): what the app does, the style wall and the FAQ
- [Room Redo on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/room-redo-ai-interior-design/id6812385415): download for iPhone
- [Privacy policy](https://www.airoomredo.com/privacy)
- [Terms of use](https://www.airoomredo.com/terms)

## FAQ

- Do I need an account? No. Your device is enough.
- What happens to my photos? They're stored so your rooms stay in My Spaces. You can delete everything from Settings in the app.
- Is the free redesign the full thing? Yes, the full redesign, with a small watermark until you subscribe.
- Which rooms work? Bedrooms, living rooms, kitchens, bathrooms, offices, balconies, and single corners.
- How long does it take? A little while. The app shows the redesign developing as it happens.
- Is it on Android? iPhone only for now.
- How do I cancel? In your iPhone's Settings, under Subscriptions. Cancel any time.

## Guides

- [Guides](https://www.airoomredo.com/guides): plain advice on redesigning a room from a photo, written by the person who built the app
